title: Great Pyramid of Giza
summary: Tomb of the pharaoh Khufu, built over about 26 years. At 146.6 m it was the tallest human-made structure on Earth for more than 3,700 years.
why: The oldest of the Seven Wonders and the only one still largely standing; a peak of ancient engineering.
interchange: Pyramids were also built in the Americas, e.g. Caral (Peru) and Teotihuacan (Mexico)
